root_cause.text: After a successful usb_register_dev(), the driver prematurely frees the as102_dev_t structure on an error path, while userspace may have already opened the device file; the .release() callback later accesses the freed structure, causing use-after-free and double-free.
root_cause.evidence: The described race condition in the CVE and commit message shows that an open() from CPU1 succeeds before usb_deregister_dev()/kfree() on CPU0, and then close() calls as102_release() which frees the already-freed as102_dev_t again. The patch removes the kfree() after usb_deregister_dev() and returns an error, deferring cleanup to .release().
